behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Undo capacity, redo and commit-after-undo branch invalidation.
Deep snapshot isolation from caller mutation.
docDelivery: Capacity counts prior states and every commit counts, including equality.
Branch/redo rules and detached JSON ownership across all returned values.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: JSON initial/committed values: acyclic plain own-data records/dense arrays/primitives, finite numbers excluding -0, no undefined/symbols/getters/custom methods. limit integer 1..100. Every commit counts even equal value.
independence: Implement isolated undo/redo history with branch truncation, capacity limits and no-op updates.
